messages:
harry (eng-security): Quick heads-up: planning base-image rebuild next week. Goals: drop a few legacy setuid helpers, tighten seccomp defaults, rotate signing keys. Need infra/runtime/ops alignment.

may (eng-runtime): Understood. Will run seccomp-strict canary on 10% pools. Any services known to need CAP_SYS_ADMIN?

harry (eng-security): We found two internal builders using loop mounts and a legacy chown helper. Ops to list runners. We'll keep old images verifiable during transition.

leo (eng-infra): For key rotation: propose dual-signing during cutover. RBAC change: grant signer SA roles/cloudkms.signer with a 3h JIT window. Example CLI in runbook.

ops (oncall): Ops: can provide 48-72h privileged shims for affected runners with audit tags. Need owners and exact runner IDs.

audit-bot: note: compliance requires audit retention >= 365 days and JSON fields: event_ts, signer.key_id, image.ref, image.digest, rebuild.id.

harry (eng-security): Action items: 1) @leo open time-limited IAM PR, 2) @may run canary and report failures, 3) @ops publish runners and owners, 4) security will draft runbook and include audit mapping. Preflight 16:00 UTC Fri.
